answer: Latency-vine enrollment gating. Each new identity must wait for a randomly assigned vine window of 12–48 hours before its first outbound traffic counts, and early bursts are held at a willow-limited rate cap. Honest agents absorb one short delay; a sybil farm must sustain each identity through its full window, and marginal cost rises at the nadir of attacker throughput since parallel identities multiply waiting and rate-limited slots.
